# Document Generation

## `/fundadmin:fund draft-capital-call <data>` {#draft-capital-call}

Draft capital call notice from sourced terms (review required)

Drafts a structured capital call notice with purpose breakdown, per-LP pro-rata table, unfunded-commitment impact, default consequences, and masked wire instructions. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund draft-capital-call` or asks to draft a capital call.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund draft-capital-call <data>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-draft-capital-call <data>` |
| Codex | `$fund-draft-capital-call <data>` |

**Writes** `CAPITAL-CALL-[fund]-[number]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-capital-call/SKILL.md)

Uses the host's approved file access and the packaged helpers where required.

Saved outputs require the report helper and an approved output folder. Otherwise, the result is an UNVERIFIED chat draft. [Output contract](/guide/outputs) · [Host support](/guide/release)

## `/fundadmin:fund draft-distribution <data>` {#draft-distribution}

Generate distribution notice with waterfall

Drafts a distribution notice: helper-supported waterfall tiers (others UNCALCULATED), per-LP split, evidenced withholding only, unfunded-commitment impact and clawback notation. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund draft-distribution` or asks to draft a distribution.

## `/fundadmin:fund draft-investor-letter <type>` {#draft-investor-letter}

Generate investor communications

Drafts LP communications with a separate review cover: quarterly update, annual meeting notice, onboarding welcome, closing, final close, extension, wind-down or ad hoc reply. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund draft-investor-letter <type>` or asks to write to LPs.

## `/fundadmin:fund draft-side-letter <terms>` {#draft-side-letter}

Generate side letter from provisions

Drafts an LP side letter from requested provisions (fee discount, MFN, co-invest, reporting, ERISA), citing a supplied LPA or marking sections [VERIFY], with conflict checks. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund draft-side-letter` or asks to draft a side letter for an LP.
